title: NDA Life #1 · NDA as a miniature: where is the passing-out parade held? (Khetarpal Ground)

captions.instagram:
Where is the NDA passing-out parade held?
A Sudan Block · B Khetarpal · C Peacock Bay
Comment your guess 👇

Answer: B, Khetarpal Ground. The passing-out course marches over the Antim Pag, the last step, to Auld Lang Syne.

At the 149th course's parade (30 Nov 2025): 1,250 cadets on parade, 329 of them passing out, and a Su-30 fly-past to finish (PIB).

Sudan Block is NDA's landmark. Peacock Bay, on Khadakwasla lake, is where cadets do water sports.

It starts with the written exam: maths is 300 of the 900 marks.

Our own model of NDA, not to scale.
